description: This file defines the RedshiftClient class, an AWS SDK client used for interacting with the Amazon Redshift service. It includes method annotations for various Redshift operations, indicating the capabilities of this client.

classes.name: RedshiftClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Redshift, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: acceptReservedNodeExchange
methods.description: Performs the accept of a reserved node exchange.

methods.name: associateDataShareConsumer
methods.description: Associates a data share with a consumer.

methods.name: authorizeClusterSecurityGroupIngress
methods.description: Authorizes ingress to a security group.

methods.name: batchDeleteClusterSnapshots
methods.description: Deletes multiple cluster snapshots in a batch.

methods.name: modifyCluster
methods.description: Modifies the settings for a cluster.
